    def read_ints():

            if neighbor != parent:
                size[node] += dfs(neighbor, node)
        return size[node]

    dfs(1, -1)

    # Calculate the best possible sum for each node
    best = [0] * (n + 1)
    def dfs3(node, parent):

        for neighbor in tree[node]:

                # Remove the contribution of the neighbor subtree
                max_sum[node] -= max(0, max_sum[neighbor])
                # Calculate the best sum for the neighbor
                dfs3(neighbor, node)
                # Add back the contribution of the neighbor subtree
                max_sum[node] += max(0, max_sum[neighbor])

                best[node] = max(best[node], max_sum[node] + max(0, best[neighbor]))
